title: Day 1: Mining Fundamentals & Mineralogy
description: Kickstart GATE MN prep with foundational mineralogy, rock-forming minerals, and Mohs hardness scale.

title: Day 2: Structural Geology & Rock Formations
description: Master geological structures: Anticlines, synclines, normal/reverse faults, joint patterns and unconformities.

title: Day 3: Coal Geology, Seam Stratigraphy & Ore Bodies
description: Gondwana vs Tertiary coalfields, proximate analysis, maceral groups, and hydrothermal ore deposits.

title: Day 4: Mine Access - Shafts, Inclines & Adits
description: Deposit factors governing choice of entry, vertical shaft vs decline trade-offs, and adit applicability.

title: Day 5: Shaft Sinking Techniques & Special Methods
description: Shaft sinking cycle: drilling, blasting, mucking, temporary & permanent lining, and freezing/caisson methods.

title: Day 6: Rock Drilling Mechanics & Penetration Rates
description: Rotary, percussive and rotary-percussive drilling, bit wear criteria, and penetration rate formulas.

title: Day 7: Commercial Explosives & Initiation Systems
description: ANFO, slurries, emulsions, nonel shock tubes, electronic delay detonators, and velocity of detonation (VOD).

title: Day 8: Surface Blast Design & Ground Vibration (PPV)
description: Calculation of burden, spacing, powder factor, subgrade drilling, and USBM vibration attenuation predictor equations.

title: Day 9: Mine Surveying - Levelling & Curvature Corrections
description: Differential, profile and reciprocal levelling, combined earth curvature and refraction error calculations.

title: Day 10: Theodolite Traversing & Coordinate Geometry
description: Latitude and departure calculations, closing error, Bowditch and Transit rule balancing of traverses.

title: Day 11: True Dip, Apparent Dip & 3-Point Borehole Problems
description: Trigonometric relations of apparent vs true dip, strike direction, and borehole depth triangulation.

title: Day 12: Modern Surveying Tools: EDM, Total Station & GPS
description: Phase shift vs pulse measurement in EDM, prism constants, satellite triangulation, and RTK GPS.

title: Day 13: Correlation Surveying & Gyro-Theodolite Alignment
description: Connecting surface grid to underground workings via plumb wires: Weisbach triangle and Weiss method.

title: Day 14: Underground Curve Setting & Transition Geometry
description: Simple circular curves by chord deflection and offsets, transition curves, and super-elevation on mine haul roads.

title: Day 15: Stress, Strain & In-Situ Stress Fields
description: Stress tensor, plane stress vs plane strain, principal stresses, and hydraulic fracturing measurement.

title: Day 16: Rock Failure Criteria: Mohr-Coulomb & Hoek-Brown
description: Cohesion, friction angle, failure envelope, and non-linear Hoek-Brown intact and rock mass criteria.

title: Day 17: Intact Rock Strength Testing (UCS & Brazilian)
description: Uniaxial Compressive Strength (UCS), indirect tensile strength by Brazilian disk test, and Point Load Index (Is50).

title: Day 18: Triaxial Rock Testing & Elastic Moduli
description: Confining pressure effects, deviatoric stress, Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, and strain energy release rate.

title: Day 19: Rock Mass Classification: RMR & Q-System
description: Bieniawski 1989 RMR parameters and Barton's Q rating equation, RQD calculations and joint condition rating.

title: Day 20: GSI & Rock Mass Modulus of Deformation
description: Geological Strength Index for massive, blocky and disintegrated rock, and empirical deformation modulus equations.

title: Day 21: Underground Coal Pillar Strength Formulas
description: Obert-Duvall, Salamon-Munro, Bieniawski, and Sheorey pillar strength formulas for Indian coal seams.

title: Day 22: Tributary Area Theory & Pillar Safety Factor
description: Vertical in-situ overburden stress, extraction ratio (R), pillar stress concentration, and safety factor calculations.

title: Day 23: Roof Support Mechanics & Rock Bolting
description: Full-column resin vs mechanical anchor bolts, suspension, beam building, keying mechanics, and pull testing.

title: Day 24: Powered Roof Supports & Surface Subsidence
description: Chock-shield supports, setting load, yield load, support density, angle of draw, and subsidence basin profiles.

title: Day 25: Bord & Pillar Development & Panel System
description: District layout, gallery width and pillar dimensions as per CMR 2017 regulations, ventilation connection.

title: Day 26: Depillaring with Stowing & Caving
description: Line of extraction, diagonal line, caving vs hydraulic sand stowing, snooks, stooks, and rib extraction.

title: Day 27: Longwall Mining: Advancing vs Retreating
description: Gate roads, tailgate, maingate, face ventilation, double-ended ranging drum shearer, and AFC conveyor.

title: Day 28: Thick Seam Mining Methods
description: Multi-slice with artificial roofing, sublevel caving, hydraulic mining, and Blanzy method.

title: Day 29: Underground Metal Mining - Open & Sublevel Stoping
description: Stope preparation, ring drilling, slot raising, drawpoints, and blast hole stoping design.

title: Day 30: Supported Stoping (Cut & Fill, Square Set)
description: Post-pillar cut and fill, hydraulic fill, cemented paste backfill, and waste rock stowing.

title: Day 31: Caving Methods: Block Caving & Sublevel Caving
description: Undercutting level, production level, drawpoint layout, drawbells, caveability, and ore dilution.

title: Day 32: Open Pit Geometry & Stripping Ratio
description: Bench height, bench width, berms, haul road gradient, overall slope angle, and instantaneous vs overall stripping ratio.

title: Day 33: Ultimate Pit Limit & Lerchs-Grossmann Algorithm
description: Floating cone technique, block economic value matrix, graph theory based ultimate pit boundary determination.

title: Day 34: Slope Stability in Open Pit Mines
description: Planar failure, wedge failure, circular failure (Bishop's simplified method), and tension crack effects.

title: Day 35: Mine Waste Dump Stability & Drainage
description: External vs internal dumps, angle of repose, liquefaction, base failure, and toe drainage design.

title: Day 36: Mine Hoisting - Drum Winders & Koepe Systems
description: Cylindrical vs bi-cylindroconical drums, multi-rope friction winders, T1/T2 slip limits, and cage acceleration cycles.

title: Day 37: Wire Ropes & Headgear Mechanics
description: Strand constructions, factor of safety regulations, fleet angle limitations, and sheaves design.

title: Day 38: Belt Conveyor Mechanics & Tractive Pull
description: Euler's friction equation T1/T2 = e^(mu*theta), belt capacity, idler spacing, take-up systems, and motor power.

title: Day 39: Mine Locomotives & Tractive Effort
description: Adhesion coefficient, tractive effort, ruling gradient, train resistance, and braking distance calculations.

title: Day 40: Shovel-Dumper Match & Productivity Sizing
description: Bucket fill factor, cycle time, truck dispatching, match factor = (Nt * St) / (Ns * Tt), and fleet sizing.

title: Day 41: Walking Draglines in Open Cast Coal Mines
description: Boom length, dump radius, digging depth, cycle time, rehandle percentage, and balancing diagrams.

title: Day 42: Continuous Surface Mining (BWE & Surface Miners)
description: Bucket wheel excavators with shiftable conveyor systems, and highwall continuous miners.

title: Day 43: Mine Atmosphere & Gas Characteristics
description: Atmospheric composition, oxygen deficiency, firedamp (CH4), blackdamp, whitedamp (CO), and stinkdamp (H2S).

title: Day 44: Gas Detection Instruments & Flame Safety Lamp
description: Methanometer principles (Wheatstone bridge catalytic detector), multi-gas detectors, and testing flame caps.

title: Day 45: Mine Climate & Geothermic Gradient
description: Virgin rock temperature, adiabatic compression (9.8 deg C per km depth), psychrometric charts, and heat stress indexes.

title: Day 46: Atkinson's Equation & Airway Resistance
description: P = (k * S * Q^2) / A^3 = R * Q^2, friction factor k, equivalent orifice A = 0.385 / sqrt(R), and unit conversions.

title: Day 47: Shock Losses & Air Power Consumption
description: Bends, expansions, contractions, regulators, and Air Power = (P * Q) / 1000 kW and motor input power.

title: Day 48: Natural Ventilation Pressure (NVP)
description: Air density differences between downcast and upcast shafts, motive column, and thermodynamic cycles on P-V diagrams.

title: Day 49: Mechanical Mine Fans & Fan Laws
description: Centrifugal vs axial flow fans, guide vanes, diffuser evasee efficiency, and fan scaling laws with speed and diameter.

title: Day 50: Fan Characteristic Curves & Operating Point
description: Head-quantity curve, mine resistance curve intersection, stall zone in axial fans, and reversing arrangements.

title: Day 51: Fans in Series & Fans in Parallel
description: Combined pressure additions in series, combined quantity additions in parallel, and booster fan placement.

title: Day 52: Ventilation Network Analysis (Kirchhoff's Laws)
description: First law (Junction balance sigma Q = 0) and Second law (Mesh balance sigma P = 0), splitting of airflow.

title: Day 53: Hardy Cross Iterative Technique for Mine Circuits
description: Successive mesh flow corrections delta Q = - sigma(R * Q * |Q|) / (2 * sigma(R * |Q|)) in complex mine networks.

title: Day 54: Spontaneous Combustion of Coal & Indexing
description: Mechanism of coal oxidation, crossing point temperature (CPT), ignition temperature, and Graham's ratio.

title: Day 55: Mine Fire Control & Stoppings Sealing
description: Fire fighting, nitrogen inertization, explosion-proof isolation stoppings, and fire gas sampling.

title: Day 56: Coward's Diagram & Mine Fire Explosibility
description: Interpretation of Coward flammability triangles (O2, CH4, CO), inert gas addition, and safe re-opening guidelines.

title: Day 57: Firedamp Explosions & Ignition Mechanics
description: Lower & upper explosive limits of CH4 (5% - 15%), ignition sources, frictional sparking, and methane layering.

title: Day 58: Coal Dust Explosions & Barrier Defenses
description: Volatile matter threshold, dispersibility, stone dust barriers (concentrated and distributed), and water trough barriers.

title: Day 59: Mine Inundation Hazards & Water Inrush Precautions
description: Working under water bodies, statutory safety barrier distances, advance exploratory boring, and burnside apparatus.

title: Day 60: Underground Water Dams & Bulkheads
description: Spherical, cylindrical and straight wedge concrete dam design, hydrostatic pressure loads, and grouting.

title: Day 61: Respirable Dust Standards & Gravimetric Sampling
description: Size fractions, PM10, PM2.5, cyclonic elutriation, statutory limits of free silica in coal/metal mines.

title: Day 62: Mine Noise, Water & Soil Pollution Standards
description: Decibel addition, Leq calculations, acid mine drainage (AMD) formation and neutralization, and soil stabilization.

title: Day 63: Environmental Impact Assessment & Reclamation
description: Baseline data collection, air dispersion modeling, EMP implementation, post-mining land use, and revegetation.

title: Day 64: Mineral Sampling Techniques & Sample Errors
description: Channel, grab, core, chip sampling, Gy's sampling theory, fundamental error, and coning and quartering.

title: Day 65: Grade Calculation & Reserve Estimation Methods
description: Weighted average grade, polygonal method, triangular method, inverse distance weighting (IDW), and Kriging concepts.

title: Day 66: Time Value of Money & Net Present Value (NPV)
description: Cash flows, discount rates, formula NPV = sigma (CF_t / (1+r)^t) - C_0, and profitability index.

title: Day 67: Internal Rate of Return & Payback Period
description: IRR calculation via interpolation, discounted payback period, depreciation (straight-line, declining balance), and depletion allowance.

title: Day 68: Break-Even Stripping Ratio & Pit Limits
description: Formula BESR = (Value of Coal - Cost of Mining) / Cost of Waste Stripping, and maximum allowable stripping ratio.

title: Day 69: Economic Cut-Off Grade Determination (Lane's Theory)
description: Mining, processing and marketing capacities, cut-off grade formula C = c / (P - s) * recovery, and optimum scheduling.

title: Day 70: Mine Production Scheduling & Ore-Waste Blending
description: Stockpile blending, grade stabilization equations, and multi-period scheduling constraints.

title: Day 71: Linear Programming in Mine Planning
description: Formulating objective functions for profit maximization, decision variables, slack variables, and Simplex method.

title: Day 72: Transportation Models & Dual Simplex
description: North-West corner rule, Vogel's approximation method (VAM), MODI stepping-stone method for coal dispatch.

title: Day 73: Project Management: CPM Critical Path Analysis
description: Activity on node (AON), forward and backward passes, earliest/latest start and finish, total float, and free float.

title: Day 74: PERT Analysis & Project Completion Probability
description: Beta distribution, expected duration te = (a + 4m + b)/6, variance sigma^2 = ((b-a)/6)^2, and z-score probability.

title: Day 75: Matrices, Rank & System of Linear Equations
description: Row operations, determinant, rank, consistency conditions, and unique/infinite/no solution tests.

title: Day 76: Eigenvalues, Eigenvectors & Cayley-Hamilton Theorem
description: Characteristic polynomial, properties of eigenvalues of symmetric/orthogonal matrices, and diagonalisation.

title: Day 77: Differential Calculus & Maxima-Minima
description: Taylor series, partial differentiation, Jacobian matrix, saddle points, and constrained optimization via Lagrange multipliers.

title: Day 78: Vector Calculus: Gradient, Divergence & Curl
description: Directional derivatives, unit normal vectors, Gauss divergence theorem, and Stokes theorem applications in engineering.

title: Day 79: Probability Fundamentals & Bayes' Theorem
description: Conditional probability, independence, Bayes formula for diagnostic testing, and combinations/permutations.

title: Day 80: Probability Distributions (Binomial, Poisson, Normal)
description: Probability mass and density functions, mean, variance, standard normal distribution (Z-tables), and central limit theorem.

title: Day 81: Numerical Solutions of Non-Linear Equations
description: Bisection method, Regula-Falsi, Newton-Raphson formula x_(n+1) = x_n - f(x_n)/f'(x_n), and order of convergence.

title: Day 82: Numerical Integration: Trapezoidal & Simpson's Rules
description: Trapezoidal rule error O(h^2), Simpson's 1/3 and 3/8 rule error O(h^4) for ore volume and area estimations.

title: Day 83: Quantitative Aptitude: Work, Time, Speed & Pipes
description: Standard shortcut methods for time and work, pipes and cisterns, relative speed, and distance problems.

title: Day 84: Percentages, Profit-Loss & Simple/Compound Interest
description: High-yield calculation techniques, weighted ratios, mixtures and alligations.

title: Day 85: GATE Spatial Aptitude & Paper Folding / Rotation
description: 2D and 3D rotation, mirrored views, pattern folding, and spatial symmetry questions introduced in modern GATE exams.

title: Day 86: Verbal Ability & Critical Reasoning for GATE
description: Reading comprehension, grammatical correctness, sentence completion, and logical deductions.

title: Day 87: Mining Geology & Development - Combined Review
description: Cross-topic integration: Structural geology, shaft selection, drilling formulas, and blast vibration equations.

title: Day 88: Advanced Surveying & Borehole Dip Calculations Sprint
description: High-intensity calculation practice for 3-point borehole problems, true/apparent dip, and coordinate balancing.

title: Day 89: Geomechanics & Rock Failure Criteria Mastery
description: Mohr-Coulomb circle construction, failure plane angles theta = 45 + phi/2, and Hoek-Brown stress computations.

title: Day 90: RMR, Q-System & Pillar Design Sizing
description: Correlating RMR with support requirements, Bieniawski pillar equations, and safety factor optimization.

title: Day 91: Tributary Area Theory & Roof Bolting Sizing
description: Numerical calculations on pillar stress concentration and bolt spacing vs roof rock load height.

title: Day 92: Bord & Pillar vs Longwall Face Mechanics
description: Depillaring lines, powered support yield ratings, and AFC load capacity numerical analysis.

title: Day 93: Underground Metal Stoping Methods Comparison
description: Selection matrix for sublevel stoping, cut-and-fill, and block caving based on ore geometry, dip, and strength.

title: Day 94: Open Pit Stripping Ratios & Slope Stability
description: Bench geometry calculation, overall pit slope factor of safety, and waste dump stability checks.

title: Day 95: Winding Systems & HEMM Productivity Formulas
description: Koepe winder slip criteria, drum payload, shovel-dumper match factor, and dragline rehandle calculations.

title: Day 96: Conveyors & Locomotive Haulage Engineering
description: Belt drive tensions T1, T2, motor power calculations, and locomotive trailing load on gradients.

title: Day 97: Atkinson's Law & Resistance Calculations
description: Airway resistance in series and parallel, equivalent orifice, and regulator sizing.

title: Day 98: Fan Laws & Series-Parallel Operation
description: Fan characteristic curves, change in fan speed/blade angle, and series vs parallel operating points.

title: Day 99: Ventilation Networks & Kirchhoff's Law Mastery
description: Solving 2-mesh and 3-mesh mine ventilation networks using iterative Hardy Cross method.

title: Day 100: Mine Fires, Coward Diagram & Explosibility Limits
description: Graham's ratio interpretation, Coward flammability triangle plotting, and safe re-opening protocols.

title: Day 101: Inundation Barriers & Environmental Compliance
description: Water dam pressure calculation, respirable dust concentration, and decibel sound level addition.

title: Day 102: Mineral Economics: NPV, IRR & Depreciation
description: Discounted cash flow modeling, straight-line and double-declining balance depreciation, and project selection.

title: Day 103: Cut-Off Grade, BESR & Production Scheduling
description: Lane's cut-off grade equations, break-even stripping ratio, and blending linear programs.

title: Day 104: Linear Programming & CPM/PERT Network Floats
description: Formulating mining simplex problems, finding critical path, free float, and independent float.

title: Day 105: Engineering Mathematics Intensive Problem Solving
description: Eigenvalues, maxima-minima, vector calculus theorems, and Simpson's numerical integration practice.

title: Day 106: Full Syllabus Revision - Geology & Blasting
description: Rapid formula recall and high-yield question solving across Mining Geology, Drivages and Blast Design.

title: Day 107: Full Syllabus Revision - Surveying & Correlation
description: Leveling, traversing, Weisbach triangle, and borehole dip numerical review.

title: Day 108: Full Syllabus Revision - Rock Mechanics & Ground Control
description: UCS, failure criteria, RMR, pillar strength formulas, and tributary area calculations review.

title: Day 109: Full Syllabus Revision - Mining Methods & Support
description: Bord & Pillar depillaring, longwall shields, metal stoping classification, and rock bolting.

title: Day 110: Full Syllabus Revision - Surface Mining & Machinery
description: Stripping ratio, slope stability, drum/Koepe winders, conveyor tensions, and shovel-dumper matching.

title: Day 111: Full Syllabus Revision - Ventilation & Gas Dynamics
description: Atkinson's equation, fan laws, series/parallel combinations, and network analysis review.

title: Day 112: Full Syllabus Revision - Hazards & Mine Environment
description: Spontaneous combustion, Coward diagram, water dams, and respirable dust compliance review.

title: Day 113: Full Syllabus Revision - Economics, Planning & Systems
description: NPV, IRR, Lane's cut-off grade, simplex method, and PERT/CPM calculations review.

title: Day 114: Full Syllabus Revision - Engineering Mathematics & Aptitude
description: Linear algebra, probability, numerical integration, and quantitative shortcuts review.

title: Day 115: High-Yield GATE MN PYQ Sprint (2018-2020)
description: Solve selected past GATE MN questions under timed conditions and review detailed explanations.

title: Day 116: High-Yield GATE MN PYQ Sprint (2021-2023)
description: Deep-dive into multi-concept numerical questions in Geomechanics, Ventilation, and Economics.

title: Day 117: High-Yield GATE MN PYQ Sprint (2024-2025)
description: Solve the most recent official papers and identify evolving problem styles and traps.

title: Day 118: Mistake Notebook Consolidation & Error Analysis
description: Revisit your personal Mistake Book: Clear unresolved M1-M6 mistakes and re-attempt problem types.

title: Day 119: Master Formula Book Final Polish
description: Comprehensive review of all mining formulas, units, dimensional consistency, and variable definitions.

title: Day 120: Exam-Day Mindset & Strategy Consolidation
description: Final review, time management strategy (Round 1 easy, Round 2 numerical, Round 3 verification), and congratulations!
